Thus the normal entry point adds a frame-wide cap unsupported by the original limits. The explicit-budget API and old-plus-new overlap accounting address configured limits, but do not justify this default.

In [clips.rs](/Users/megasoft78/Desktop/Freelance/vexel/.cache/WO-RUST-SVG-ANIMATION-FRAME-01/worker/rust/crates/vexel-svg-animation-frame/src/clips.rs:143), `bounds_for_node` scans shapes without charging per shape; `shape_has_node` charges only while walking ancestry. A long run of shapes with no transform node or edges can therefore pass without observing cancellation, including after a contributing shape has already been found. The new cancellation tests cover clone estimation, capacity measurement, and clip-owner traversal, but not this bounds scan.
